text: <@U0OWNER> customers say their newest orders are missing from the Orders page since this morning: page 1 starts at their 21st most recent order. Account acme-demo shows it too. The list comes from bench-orders-api, GET /orders.
Reproduced on acme-demo: GET /orders?page=1&limit=20 returns orders 21 to 40, page=2 returns 41 to 60. The 20 newest are on no page at all.
The mobile app sends page=1 for the first page as well, same result there. Nothing changed on the client side.
The order count on the dashboard is right, only the list is off.
